tools.name: launch
tools.description: Launch a process and optionally wait for readiness patterns in its output. Use runCommand for commands that finish on their own.

raw.description: If true, preserve raw ANSI escape codes in output (default: false, returns clean text)

tools.name: runCommand
tools.description: Run a command in a session (auto-creates the session if it does not exist)

session.description: Session name (will be created automatically if it does not exist)

cwd.description: Working directory (used when auto-creating a new session)

timeout.description: Command timeout in ms (default: 30000). Use -1 to return immediately without waiting.

raw.description: If true, preserve raw ANSI escape codes in output (default: false, returns clean text)

tools.name: tailLogs
tools.description: Get recent logs from a session

raw.description: If true, preserve raw ANSI escape codes in output (default: false, returns clean text)

tools.name: sendInput
tools.description: Send input to an interactive session. Text is sent verbatim; use `keys` for special keys (Enter, Ctrl+C, arrows, ...) since raw control characters cannot pass through the JSON layer.

input.description: Literal text to type (can be empty when only sending keys)

keys.description: Named keys sent after the text, tmux send-keys style: Enter, Tab, Shift-Tab, Esc, Space, Backspace, Delete, Up, Down, Left, Right, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, F1-F12, C-a..C-z (Ctrl), M-<char> (Alt). E.g. ["Enter"] to submit in a TUI, ["C-c"] for Ctrl+C, ["Esc"] to dismiss.

appendNewline.description: Append Enter (\r) after input. Default: true when `keys` is absent, false when `keys` is given.

tools.name: sendSignal
tools.description: Send a signal to a session (e.g., SIGINT for Ctrl+C)

graceful.description: If false, force kills immediately. Default true for graceful shutdown with 3s timeout
If false, force kills immediately. Default true for graceful shutdown with 3s timeout

tools.name: searchLogs
tools.description: Search for patterns in session logs

context.description: Number of context lines to show (default: 3)

raw.description: If true, preserve raw ANSI escape codes in output (default: false, returns clean text)

tools.name: takeScreenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the terminal session (useful for visually rich TUIs, ANSI art, progress bars)

lines.description: Number of recent lines to capture (default: 50)

outputPath.description: Optional file path to save screenshot (returns base64 if omitted)
